description:
## The filed question was wrong

This was filed as 'compile_root_jit: dead API or parity gap'. It is neither. Reading the two:

  compile_root_jit: native_program_for_root(root) -> compile_native_backend(JitBackend) -> return (compiled, entry)
  run_root_jit:     native_program_for_root(root) -> compile_native_backend(JitBackend) -> run it

run_root_jit does not call compile_root_jit. It repeats the same two steps inline, down to an identical error-format string. So this is not an unshipped capability -- it is one idea written twice, where the shipped copy is the longer one.

## The fix

Make run_root_jit call compile_root_jit and then run the result. That gives compile_root_jit a production caller and deletes the duplication in one motion, instead of choosing between deleting a front door and gating one.

## Check while there

Confirm the error text stays identical from a caller's view, and confirm no third site repeats the same prefix (compile_root_aot has the same shape and may or may not share it honestly).
title: Fold run_root_jit onto compile_root_jit
